region_context: Malaysia-focused careers; international evidence is contextual
purpose: Illustrate how readiness rankings can change if the relative importance of selected skills increases under faster AI adoption. Not an adoption forecast.
no_change_at_0_or_100_note: With strictly positive weights, users possessing zero/all required skills always score 0/100 in either scenario.
interpretation: The factors adjust relative scoring priorities; they do not represent percentage probability of replacement, demand growth, or training efficacy.
